description: The 3Blue1Brown YouTube channel creates animated math videos that focus on visualizing core concepts to make complex topics intuitive and accessible. The videos cover a wide range of subjects, from pure math like calculus and linear algebra to adjacent fields including physics, computer science, and neural networks. The creator, Grant Sanderson, uses custom animation to build understanding from concrete examples, often exploring topics like the Fourier transform, the central limit theorem, and how large language models work.
